hiringEvidencePacket.auditSummary: The materials establish the candidate's role in maintaining plans, hosting calls, drafting reports, and escalating risks, but do not establish end-to-end ownership or sole responsibility for go-live sign-off. The candidate's claim of 'running implementations end-to-end' is contradicted by the delivery manager handling consultant assignments and go-live sign-off. The head of delivery expects the candidate to have held go-live sign-off and managed consultant assignments, which the materials do not confirm.
limitations: No evidence of end-to-end ownership or sole go-live sign-off
Candidate's subjective claim of 'running end-to-end' contradicted by source
